prior_policy_diagnostic.scope: Retained failed17.4s source-posture policy. Different frozen implementation identities are explicit; this before/after record is not a same-runtime controlled experiment. No historical receipt is relabeled or duplicated.

scope: Pinned ARX belt P5 with the explicit authored zero-lateral policy, not latest ARX. Exact source scenarios and numeric thresholds, original clock and matched phase, separate adverse task failures. Half-timestep checks cover nominal plus four critical ordinary cases only. Payload drop is reported separately and is not an ordinary source acceptance criterion. No hardware qualification or continuous whole-state-space guarantee.
